title: Husband, 32, With 'Months To Live' Has $1.2M Life Insurance And Asks If He Should Put 50% Of It In Annuity So His Wife Doesn't Blow It
text: He's dying at 32. His wife is getting $1.2 million. And he's terrified she'll waste it. In a blunt Reddit post, a terminally ill man shared his financial dilemma with the r/personalfinance community. "I'm dying in a few months," he wrote. "I have a $1,200,000 life insurance [policy] w/ my wife as beneficiary… What should I do to ensure my wife gets the money w/o difficulty?
